name: Atlassoft Post Type Reorder
author: atlassoftwebwp

sections.description:
Atlas Post Type Reorder allows you to easily reorder posts and custom post types directly from the WordPress admin area using a clean drag & drop interface.

This plugin supports:
* Any public post type
* Custom post types created by themes or plugins
* Simple, lightweight and compatible with all modern WordPress setups

There are no complex settings — just activate the plugin, open any post type, and start reordering.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Go to any post type screen → click on “Reorder”.
  4. Drag and drop posts into the desired order.
